Structured extraction requires schemas, source evidence, edge-case rules, human calibration, and adjudication. Harmonization also requires recoverable final labels and decision rules.
Full-text automation can depend on PDF parsing, OCR, table and section handling, context limits, chunking, truncation, and access to supplementary files.
Prompt, schema, and workflow revisions expose failed approaches and the design choices needed to obtain usable outputs.
Established guidance requires reporting review methods and technically consequential search decisions at the protocol, method, result, and availability levels.
